title: Hank Bellis and the Casino Royale band
summary: Schiro played with trumpeter Hank at the Casino Royale; showmanship and a bandleader singer.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh he did some time back and he had a slight hemorrhage or something so he quit. In fact I think he sold his horn Sunday night to Johnny Newroth, his nephew. Oh yeah. I think he's always one of the...well he played a fine horn. I played with Hank over at the Casino Royale, that's Al Hurts. I used to call it the Casino Royale and I think Stormy was there at the time. And they had a Hawaiian band on one side and an hour band had the flow show and the band on the other side. They had Al Moore on trombone, Cyril Dill on drums, and a piano man I think his name was Greenwald. And Hank was on trumpet and I was on sax and clarinet. It sounded nice. And Hank was...Hank had a style out of his world. He was a good showman and all. He used to beat himself in his estrelite, put the spotlight on him.
